ui.cred_hint: Stored locally in git-credential-store format and injected via credential.helper for every command this app runs.
cmd.clone: Clone a repository into a new directory
cmd.add: Add file contents to the index
cmd.rm: Remove files from working tree and index
cmd.rebase: Reapply commits on top of another branch
cmd.pull: Fetch and integrate with another repository
cmd.blame: Show who last modified each line
cmd.describe: Human readable name of a commit
cmd.reset: Reset current HEAD to a state
cmd.bisect: Find the commit that introduced a bug
cmd.archive: Create an archive of files from a tree
cmd.bundle: Move objects and refs by archive
arg.name: name
wf.clone.title: Clone repository
wf.clone.desc: Download a remote repository to a local directory.
wf.init.title: Initialize repository

wf.status.title: Status & changes
wf.status.desc: Overview of the current branch and changed files.
wf.commit.title: Commit changes
wf.commit.desc: Stage selected files and create a commit.
wf.pull.title: Pull
wf.pull.desc: Fetch from remote and merge into the current branch.
wf.push.title: Push

wf.branch_delete.title: Delete branch

wf.merge.title: Merge branch
wf.merge.desc: Merge another branch into the current one.
wf.conflicts.title: Resolve merge conflicts
wf.conflicts.desc: List conflicted files, mark them resolved, continue or abort the merge.
wf.stash_push.title: Stash changes
wf.stash_push.desc: Save local changes aside without committing.
wf.stash_list.title: List stashes
wf.stash_pop.title: Apply stash

wf.log.title: Log
wf.diff.title: Diff
wf.remote_list.title: List remotes
wf.remote_add.title: Add remote
wf.remote_add.param.name: Name (e.g. origin)
wf.remote_remove.title: Remove remote
wf.remote_remove.param.name: Name
wf.set_identity.title: Set identity
wf.set_identity.desc: Set user.name and user.email needed for commits.
wf.set_identity.param.name: Name
wf.fix_safe_directory.title: Fix 'dubious ownership'
wf.fix_safe_directory.desc: Mark a directory as safe (needed for repos on shared Android storage).
wf.undo_last_commit.title: Undo last commit
wf.undo_last_commit.desc: Reset to the previous commit but keep all changes staged.
err.merge_conflict.title: Merge conflict
err.merge_conflict.detail: Automatic merge failed — some files have conflicts. Resolve them, mark them with 'git add', then continue the merge (or abort).
err.divergent_branches.title: Divergent branches
err.divergent_branches.detail: Local and remote have diverged and git does not know whether to merge or rebase. Choose one — or set pull.rebase/pull.ff in the config.
err.dubious_ownership.title: Dubious ownership
err.dubious_ownership.detail: git refuses to work in this directory because it is owned by another user (common for /storage/emulated/0 on Android). Mark it as safe.
err.local_changes_overwritten.title: Local changes would be overwritten
err.local_changes_overwritten.detail: The operation cannot proceed without losing local edits. Stash them first or discard them.
err.need_commit_or_stash.title: Commit or stash first
err.need_commit_or_stash.detail: You have uncommitted changes that would be overwritten. Commit or stash them first.
err.non_fast_forward.title: Push rejected (non-fast-forward)
err.non_fast_forward.detail: The remote has commits you don't have locally. Pull first. Force-push only if you really want to overwrite remote history.
err.auth_failed.title: Authentication failed
err.auth_failed.detail: Credentials missing or wrong. Store username + password/token for the host, or check the remote URL.
err.repo_not_found.title: Repository not found
err.repo_not_found.detail: The URL is wrong or you have no access. Check the URL and your credentials.
err.not_a_repo.title: Not a git repository
err.not_a_repo.detail: Select a repository first, or initialize one.
err.no_identity.title: No identity configured
err.no_identity.detail: git needs user.name and user.email to create commits. Set them now.
err.no_upstream.title: No upstream branch
err.no_upstream.detail: The current branch has no upstream. Push with -u to set it.
err.branch_exists.title: Branch already exists
err.branch_exists.detail: Choose another name or switch to the existing branch.
err.branch_not_merged.title: Branch not fully merged
err.branch_not_merged.detail: The branch contains commits that are not merged. Merge it first or force-delete.
err.unrelated_histories.title: Unrelated histories
err.unrelated_histories.detail: The histories share no common commit. Retry with --allow-unrelated-histories if that is intended.
err.nothing_to_commit.title: Nothing to commit
err.already_up_to_date.title: Already up to date
err.unknown_workflow.title: Unknown workflow
